request.text: My shoulders are tight after video calls. Set a reminder for 4:00 p.m. today to take a screen break, and right now talk me through a one-minute seated neck-and-shoulder reset. Please don't move or gesture.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a reminder for 4:00 p.m. today to take a screen break.
Immediately provide a one-minute seated neck-and-shoulder reset using speech only, without Chromie moving or gesturing.

new_goals.source_text: Set a reminder for 4:00 p.m. today to take a screen break.
constraints: Use today at 4:00 p.m. as the due time.
success_criteria: One reminder is created for the specified time and purpose.

new_goals.description: Talk the user through a one-minute seated neck-and-shoulder reset now.
new_goals.source_text: Right now talk me through a one-minute seated neck-and-shoulder reset. Please don't move or gesture.
constraints: Keep the reset seated and approximately one minute.
Do not add Chromie body movement or gestures.
success_criteria: The user receives concise spoken instructions for the requested seated reset without robot body action.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The turn establishes a future reminder Goal and a separate immediate spoken-guidance Goal.

semantic_facts: The plan must create a 4:00 p.m. today screen-break reminder and separately provide the requested one-minute seated reset as immediate speech.
The future stateful effect and immediate guidance have separate completion criteria and may be prepared independently.
The user's no-movement constraint applies to Chromie, so no embodied Capability belongs in the spoken reset.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims the reminder was created or the user completed the reset before trusted completion evidence.
The two Goals are merged into reminder text, causing the immediate spoken reset to be omitted.
The planner adds a gaze, blink, or locomotion action despite the explicit speech-only constraint.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A delayed reminder and an immediate guidance Goal are collapsed because both concern taking a break.
The planner ignores a cross-Goal modality constraint and introduces unnecessary embodied behavior.
